parts.title: Crocodile Study
parts.transcript: Part 4. Saltwater crocodile research, Northern Territory, Australia. First time a satellite used to track crocodiles (31). Previous studies used radio (32), unreliable as the signal was lost (33). Questions: how far they travel; how easily can crocodiles navigate (34). Challenge: they avoid people (35). Three crocodiles tagged and relocated by helicopter (36); transmitter on the head (37). Each stayed weeks then swam home by the most direct route (38). May navigate using senses and the position of the sun (39), possibly the same system as birds (40).
